d: Short, chestnut brown hair with straight bangs and a side-parted style is visible under a hood. The eyes are small, narrowed, and sharp-looking, framed by rectangular glasses on a mature face appearing to be in the late teens. The build is slender and lean, dressed in a brown and tan camouflage-patterned hooded cloak draped over a matching camouflage tactical outfit consisting of a high-collar shirt, cargo pants with knee pads, and brown lace-up combat boots. A large, matte black sniper rifle is held across the chest, complemented by black fingerless gloves and a black sleeve on the left arm.
